title: Minecraft Votifier Setup Helper | NuVotifier Vote Checklist
description: Generate a Votifier setup checklist for vote sites, NuVotifier, reward plugins, ports, keys, and testing votes.
intro: Create a practical checklist for connecting a Minecraft server to voting sites with NuVotifier and a reward plugin.
howTo: Install NuVotifier and a reward plugin.
Choose a port your host allows and copy the public key.
Add the host, port, and public key to each voting/listing site.
Send a test vote and confirm the reward fires in console.
faqs: Does NuVotifier give rewards by itself?
No. NuVotifier listens for votes. You need a reward plugin or custom listener to give rewards.
Use a port allowed by your host or firewall. Avoid reusing the Minecraft join port unless your setup specifically requires it.
Common causes are closed ports, wrong public key, wrong host, proxy/backend plugin placement, or reward plugin config errors.
